HYTHE by Botanica

Condominium in Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale), within Botanica Grand Avenue / Laguna Phuket area
HomePhuket PropertyCondos for SaleHYTHE by Botanica

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

HYTHE by Botanica is a low-rise condominium in the Laguna Phuket / Cherngtalay area, within the Botanica Grand Avenue development. It is the first condominium project by Botanica Luxury Villas and is marketed as a vertical villa. The project comprises four six-storey buildings and a clubhouse, with one- to three-bedroom units, duplexes with private pools and penthouses.

HYTHE by Botanica: key facts

  • HYTHE by Botanica is a low-rise condominium in Cherngtalay, Phuket, developed by Botanica Luxury Phuket Co., Ltd.
  • Units: 1–4 bedrooms, 57–716 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Dec 2025 (agent listings).
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿11,475,000 (agent advertised price).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Laguna Golf Phuket (1.1 km); SAii Laguna Phuket (2.3 km); Thalang Hospital Phuket (4.0 km); HEI Schools Phuket (6.7 km).
